### Day 92: Proverbs 6:20–35
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-92-proverbs-6-2035.html
Passage: Proverbs 6:20-35
Points:
- Adultery threatens marriage and family life, so believers must take scriptural warnings seriously.
- Neglecting personal duty and staying idle makes one vulnerable to boredom and temptation.
- Abandoning accountability leaves a person answering to no one when moral compromises arise.
- Spiritual rebellion frequently takes root in seasons of loneliness and isolation.
- Believers must welcome friends who love them enough to question questionable behavior.
